name: query_over_local_cap
text: We need to decide which asynchronous runtime to adopt for the API server, weighing ecosystem maturity, performance under sustained load, the size of the dependency tree, how well it integrates with the existing tracing and metrics stack, and whether the team has prior experience operating it in production. The decision also has to account for how easy it is to test deterministically and how the choice constrains future work on background jobs and scheduled tasks.
